description: This file is a C++ source code file implementing a command-line utility for displaying detailed information about build targets or configurations in a build system, specifically for the 'gn desc' command. It includes functions for printing target and config descriptions, handling command-line arguments, and outputting information in JSON or text format.

classes.name: PrintCallbackHolder
classes.description: A helper class that manages swapping and restoring print callbacks for build settings during the execution of the 'gn desc' command.

methods.name: PrintCallbackHolder::SwapCallbacks
methods.description: Sets a new print callback for build settings and stores the previous one to restore later.

methods.name: RunDesc
methods.description: Main function executing the 'gn desc' command, parsing arguments, setting up the environment, resolving targets/configs, and outputting their descriptions in JSON or text format.
